items.name: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation

scope.zh: 新理论、新方法：电子结构、分子动力学、统计力学及其重要应用；也欢迎量子计算的新理论、与化学相关的数据科学，以及带来创新方法的计算化学程序。明确不收：只用成熟方法（DFT、传统波函数方法、分子动力学）计算单一类体系的直接应用；偏好理论、方法和数据科学上有进展、并用于有意义的化学或材料问题的工作。
scope.en: New theory and methods in electronic structure, molecular dynamics and statistical mechanics and their important applications; also quantum-computing theory, chemistry-relevant data science, and software that brings new methods. It does not consider straightforward applications of established methods (DFT, conventional wavefunction methods, MD) to a single class of systems, and favours advances in theory, methods or data science applied to compelling chemistry or materials problems.

types.zh: Article（主体）；Letter：最多 4 个期刊页（约 16 页双倍行距稿，含全部内容），摘要 ≤75 词；Review：约 10,000 词（不含参考文献和图），须受邀或先提交选题申请（Proposal，1–2 页）获批；Perspective：同样须受邀或申请获批。
types.en: Articles (the main format); Letters: up to four journal pages (about 16 double-spaced pages, everything included), abstract ≤75 words; Reviews: about 10,000 words (excluding references and graphics), by invitation or after an accepted 1–2 page proposal; Perspectives: by invitation or accepted proposal.

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可付费选金色开放获取（CC BY 或 CC BY-NC-ND，不少机构与 ACS 签有开放获取协议，可覆盖费用）；也可选零禁运绿色开放（已接受稿以 CC BY 存入机构或资助方知识库，需付文章发展费 ADC，官网写明统一 2,500 美元）；或在发表 12 个月后免费存放已接受稿。
oa.en: Hybrid: optional gold open access (CC BY or CC BY-NC-ND; many institutions have ACS agreements that cover the fee); zero-embargo green OA (the accepted manuscript under CC BY in a repository, for an article development charge listed as a flat USD 2,500); or free deposit of the accepted manuscript 12 months after publication.

review.zh: 推荐审稿人是选填项：编辑会参考但不保证采用；不要推荐同单位或有实际、潜在利益冲突的人，尽量给机构邮箱。被拒后编辑可能建议转投其他 ACS 期刊（Manuscript Transfer）。
review.en: Suggesting reviewers is optional; editors consider but cannot always use them. Avoid people from your institution or with real or perceived conflicts, and give institutional e-mails. After a decline the editors may suggest a transfer to another ACS journal.

preprint.zh: 允许投稿前把初稿放到 ChemRxiv、arXiv、bioRxiv 等预印本平台。要在 cover letter 里说明，并写清预印本与投稿稿的差别；发表后在预印本上加正式文章的 DOI 链接。
preprint.en: An initial draft may be posted on ChemRxiv, arXiv, bioRxiv or a similar server before submission. Mention it in the cover letter, say how the submitted version differs, and link the preprint to the published DOI afterwards.

data.zh: 执行 ACS 研究数据政策第 2 级：投稿时必须附数据可用性声明（Data Availability Statement），鼓励把支撑结果的全部数据存入合适的公共知识库并规范引用。
data.en: Applies ACS Research Data Policy Level 2: a Data Availability Statement is required at submission, and authors are encouraged to share all underlying data in a suitable public repository and cite it.

si.zh: SI 与正文同时提交，审稿时提供给审稿人，发表后对所有读者免费。正文在致谢和参考文献之前要有一段“Supporting Information”，逐个文件写明内容和文件类型（例如“所有优化结构的笛卡尔坐标（XYZ）”）；只写“图 S1–S3”不合格。
si.en: Supporting Information is submitted with the manuscript, shown to reviewers and free to all readers after publication. Before the acknowledgments and references, add a "Supporting Information" paragraph naming the contents and file type of every file (for example "Cartesian coordinates of all optimized structures (XYZ)"); "Figures S1–S3" alone is not acceptable.

tpl.zh: 首次投稿可用 Fast Format：不必套期刊版式，但标准章节要齐全、图表嵌在正文相应位置。ACS 在 Templates and Guidelines 页提供各刊模板，作者指南另有 TeX/LaTeX 稿件说明。
tpl.en: First submissions may use Fast Format: no journal layout is needed, but all standard sections must be present and graphics embedded where they belong. ACS offers journal templates on its Templates and Guidelines page, and the guidelines cover TeX/LaTeX manuscripts.

items.name: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A

scope.zh: 分子、离子、自由基、团簇和气溶胶的物理化学（实验、理论、计算都收），侧重大气与环境化学、气溶胶、分子地球化学、燃烧、天体化学、等离子体、冷分子、催化和含能材料等。JPC 三刊共同的录用标准是“新的物理洞见”；A4 栏目收对物理化学界有广泛用处的新工具和新方法，对物理洞见的要求放宽。
scope.en: Physical chemistry of molecules, ions, radicals, clusters and aerosols (experiment, theory and computation), with emphasis on atmospheric and environmental chemistry, aerosols, molecular geochemistry, combustion, astrochemistry, plasmas, cold molecules, catalysis and energetic materials. The key criterion for all JPC parts is new physical insight; section A4 takes new tools and methods of broad interest, where that requirement is relaxed.

types.zh: Article：无字数上限，但要求尽量简洁，须附目录图（TOC）；Letter 和 Communication 一律投 JPC Letters。Featured Article（多为邀请，约 8 个印刷页）、Review（邀请，约 8 页）、Mini-Review（邀请，约 4 页）、Perspective（主要邀请，4–6 页，摘要 ≤150 词）、Viewpoint，以及 Tutorial（关键计算或实验技术的入门教程，要求可复现，并在 SI 里附代表性输入文件或脚本）。
types.en: Articles: no word limit but should be concise, with a TOC graphic; all Letters and Communications go to JPC Letters. Featured Articles (mostly invited, ~8 printed pages), Reviews (invited, ~8 pages), Mini-Reviews (invited, ~4 pages), Perspectives (mainly invited, 4–6 pages, abstract ≤150 words), Viewpoints, and Tutorials (self-contained introductions to key computational or experimental techniques; reproducibility is central, with representative input files or scripts in the SI).

The rules follow two IUPAC reports from 1998. Crystal or surface structures go in the SI as CIF files. All ACS journals strongly encourage authors to make the data behind a paper public at publication and to cite data sets properly (ACS Research Data Policy).

scope.en: New basic research of interest to physical chemists, biophysical chemists and chemical physicists; the key criterion is an advance or physical insight that warrants rapid publication. Papers that mainly report data, data applications, device performance or literature reviews are generally unsuitable. Theory papers must at least give significant new physical insight into an experimentally relevant system or present a new method of general interest (the guidelines list further criteria).

types.zh: Letter：建议 1,500–4,000 词，图、方案和插图合计 3–5 个，摘要 ≤150 词，须有 TOC 图，投稿时就要是无错的最终稿；Perspective（仅邀请，约 20–30 页双倍行距）；Viewpoint、Commentary（仅邀请）。
types.en: Letters: preferably 1,500–4,000 words with 3–5 figures, schemes and illustrations in total, abstract ≤150 words, TOC graphic required, submitted in final error-free form; Perspectives (invitation only, ~20–30 double-spaced pages); Viewpoints and Commentaries (invitation only).

The key criterion is new physical insight or new tools and methods of general interest. Main areas: molecules, clusters and aerosols; biophysics, biomaterials, liquids and soft matter; energy, materials and catalysis.

types.zh: Article：要求代表该子领域每年前 10% 的进展，摘要通常 ≤300 词；Letter：摘要、正文和图注合计 ≤2,200 词（约 5 个图，参考文献不计）。
types.en: Articles: expected top-10% advances, abstract typically ≤300 words; Letters: abstract, text and captions ≤2,200 words (about five graphics, references excluded).

oa.zh: 完全开放获取，接收后须付 APC；默认许可 CC BY-NC-ND，可升级为 CC BY；有会员和国家折扣。
oa.en: Fully open access with an APC after acceptance; default licence CC BY-NC-ND, upgradable to CC BY; member and country discounts apply.

preprint.zh: 允许投稿前把初稿放到 ChemRxiv、arXiv、bioRxiv 等预印本平台。要在 cover letter 里说明，并写清预印本与投稿稿的差别；发表后在预印本上加正式文章的 DOI 链接。
preprint.en: An initial draft may be posted on ChemRxiv, arXiv, bioRxiv or a similar server before submission. Mention it in the cover letter, say how the submitted version differs, and link the preprint to the published DOI afterwards.

data.zh: 执行 ACS 研究数据政策第 1 级：鼓励公开论文结果背后的全部数据，最好存入合适的公共知识库。
data.en: Applies ACS Research Data Policy Level 1: authors are encouraged to share all data underlying the results, preferably in a suitable public repository.

si.zh: SI 与正文同时提交，审稿时提供给审稿人，发表后对所有读者免费。正文在致谢和参考文献之前要有一段“Supporting Information”，逐个文件写明内容和文件类型（例如“所有优化结构的笛卡尔坐标（XYZ）”）；只写“图 S1–S3”不合格。
si.en: Supporting Information is submitted with the manuscript, shown to reviewers and free to all readers after publication. Before the acknowledgments and references, add a "Supporting Information" paragraph naming the contents and file type of every file (for example "Cartesian coordinates of all optimized structures (XYZ)"); "Figures S1–S3" alone is not acceptable.

tpl.zh: 首次投稿可用 Fast Format：不必套期刊版式，但标准章节要齐全、图表嵌在正文相应位置。ACS 在 Templates and Guidelines 页提供各刊模板，作者指南另有 TeX/LaTeX 稿件说明。
tpl.en: First submissions may use Fast Format: no journal layout is needed, but all standard sections must be present and graphics embedded where they belong. ACS offers journal templates on its Templates and Guidelines page, and the guidelines cover TeX/LaTeX manuscripts.

scope.zh: 现代化学物理和物理化学各领域的前沿研究；也发表重要新发现的简短 Communication、领域进展的 Perspective 和专题（Special Topics）。各栏目覆盖的方向见期刊的 Focus and Coverage 页。
scope.en: Cutting-edge research in all areas of modern chemical physics and physical chemistry, plus brief Communications of significant findings, Perspectives and Special Topics. The topical sections are described on the journal's Focus and Coverage page.

types.zh: Article、Communication、Perspective、Tutorial、Review、Software。Communication 上限 3,500 词（图、公式、表格和参考文献不计），用于需要快速发表的重要初步结果，审稿和生产都优先处理；因篇幅短，论证的证明标准略放宽，完整证明可以之后另发 Article。
types.en: Articles, Communications, Perspectives, Tutorials, Reviews and Software. Communications are limited to 3,500 words (figures, equations, tables and references not counted), for important preliminary results that need rapid publication, with priority in review and production; the standard of proof is somewhat relaxed and full proof may follow in an Article.

sources.zh: AIP Publishing 化学物理期刊一览

oa.zh: 混合开放获取。
oa.en: Hybrid open access.

sources.zh: AIP Publishing 化学物理期刊一览

preprint.zh: 可以在投稿前或接收前把预印本放到 arXiv 等非商业免费预印本平台（需加 AIP 规定的版权说明），并建议预印本至少用 CC BY-NC 许可；接收稿可在接收后立即公开。
preprint.en: A preprint may be posted on a non-commercial free server such as arXiv before submission or acceptance (with AIP's credit line), preferably under at least CC BY-NC; the accepted manuscript may be posted immediately on acceptance.

sources.zh: AIP Publishing 在线分享规定

data.zh: 投稿时要提供数据可用性声明；AIP Publishing 认为支撑结论的数据集都应能被读者获取，鼓励存入公共知识库。 报告新势能面的论文必须附 PES.tar 归档文件，里面要有能生成势能（最好也给出受力）、可用于经典轨迹计算的程序；只有简单到能从论文直接重建的势能例外。
data.en: A data availability statement is requested at submission; AIP Publishing wants the data sets behind the conclusions available to readers and encourages public repositories. Papers on new potential energy surfaces must include a PES.tar archive with a program that generates the potential (preferably also forces) for trajectory calculations, unless the potential can be rebuilt from the paper alone.

sources.zh: AIP Publishing 研究数据政策

tpl.zh: 可用 Word 或 LaTeX；AIP 作者须知分别写了 Word 和 LaTeX 用户的要求和首次投稿的格式。
tpl.en: Word or LaTeX; the AIP author instructions cover Word and LaTeX users and the format for first submissions.

num.zh: AIP 化学物理期刊一览页列出：影响因子 3.7（页面注明来自 Clarivate 2026 年发布的 JCR），从投稿到首次决定平均 28 天、到接收平均 78 天、到发表平均 102 天（页面注明速度因文章类型而异）。
num.en: The AIP chemical physics portfolio page lists an Impact Factor of 3.7 (Clarivate JCR released in 2026, per the page), and averages of 28 days to first decision, 78 days to acceptance and 102 days to publication (speeds vary by article type).

sources.zh: AIP Publishing 化学物理期刊一览

scope.zh: 化学与物理交叉领域的原创实验和理论研究，目标是在原子和分子层面全面理解各类体系的物理和化学性质。
scope.en: Original experimental and theoretical research at the interface of chemistry and physics, aiming at a full understanding of physical and chemical properties at the atomic and molecular level.

types.zh: Letter、Article、Review、Perspective、Comment（以政策页的列表为准）。Letter：≤2,000 词，图和表合计 ≤3 个，摘要 ≤150 词，参考文献 ≤15 篇；发 Letter 不妨碍以后把更完整的论文投给 CJCP 或其他期刊。
types.en: Letters, Articles, Reviews, Perspectives and Comments (per the policies page). Letters: ≤2,000 words, at most three figures or tables, abstract ≤150 words, ≤15 references; a fuller article may still go to CJCP or elsewhere later.

scope.zh: 计算化学的各个方面：分析、生物、无机、有机、物理和材料化学中的计算。Full Paper 要报告基础理论、计算方法及其应用的重要进展，与实验数据相互印证、或对实验可观测量和新材料性质有实质预测价值的理论工作尤其受欢迎。
scope.en: All aspects of computational chemistry across analytical, biological, inorganic, organic, physical and materials chemistry. Full Papers report important advances in theory, methods and applications; theory correlated with experiment or with real predictive value for observables or new materials is especially welcome.

types.zh: Full Paper：150 词摘要 + TOC 图和 75 词 TOC 简介，正文要有足以复现工作的 Methods 部分；Review；Rapid Communication：≤1,500 词、≤3 个图表、≤20 篇参考文献，审稿和发表最快；Software News and Updates：介绍新程序或升级（以商业宣传为主的不收）。
types.en: Full Papers: 150-word abstract plus TOC image and 75-word summary, with a Methods section detailed enough to reproduce the work; Reviews; Rapid Communications: ≤1,500 words, ≤3 display items, ≤20 references, with the fastest review; Software News and Updates on new or upgraded programs (mainly commercial content is not accepted).

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可通过 OnlineOpen 付费开放获取，许可可选 CC BY、CC BY-NC 或 CC BY-NC-ND；不少机构与 Wiley 签有开放获取协议。
oa.en: Hybrid: paid open access through OnlineOpen under CC BY, CC BY-NC or CC BY-NC-ND; many institutions have Wiley agreements.

review.zh: 封闭审稿：审稿人身份不向作者公开（审稿人要求且编辑认为合适时除外）；送审的原创研究一般至少两位专家评审；不送审的稿件通常 5 个工作日内退回。
review.en: Closed review: reviewer identities are not disclosed unless a reviewer asks and the editor agrees; original research normally goes to at least two experts; manuscripts not sent for review are usually returned within five working days.

preprint.zh: Wiley 允许投稿已发过预印本的稿件（发预印本不保证一定送审）；发表后请在预印本上链接正式文章。
preprint.en: Wiley journals accept submissions that were posted as preprints (this does not guarantee review); link the preprint to the published article afterwards.

data.zh: 报告从头算电子结构或力场计算的论文，应遵循 IUPAC 的相应规范（J. Comput. Chem. 20, 1587–1590 和 1591–1592）。
data.en: Papers with ab initio electronic structure or force-field calculations should follow the IUPAC guidelines (J. Comput. Chem. 20, 1587–1590 and 1591–1592).

si.zh: 补充材料可上传 .pdf、.doc、.docx、.rtf 或 .ps，标为“supplementary material for review”。
si.en: Supplementary material for review may be uploaded as .pdf, .doc, .docx, .rtf or .ps and designated "supplementary material for review".

tpl.zh: 模板不强制，但推荐使用：有 Full Paper、Rapid Communication、Review、Software News 和 LaTeX 模板。主文档可用 Word 或 LaTeX；在 Research Exchange 用 LaTeX 投稿时须另传一份 PDF 供审稿。首次投稿可用 Free Format。
tpl.en: Templates are recommended but optional (Full Paper, Rapid Communication, Review, Software News and LaTeX). The main file may be Word or LaTeX; LaTeX submissions in Research Exchange also need a PDF for review. Free Format is accepted for first submissions.

scope.zh: 综述型期刊：用化学和物理理论与计算机建模研究分子科学的各个方面，连接化学、生物、材料科学及相关应用领域。
scope.en: A review journal using chemical and physical theory and computer modeling to study all aspects of the molecular sciences, bridging chemistry, biology, materials science and applied fields.

types.zh: 只发表 WIREs 系列的综述类文章，多为邀请；未受邀的作者可以提交选题申请表，编辑批准后受邀投稿。各文章类型的要求写在 WIREs 模板里。
types.en: Only WIREs review-type articles, mostly invited; uninvited authors may send an article proposal and are invited to submit if it is approved. Requirements per article type are in the WIREs template.

oa.zh: 混合：可选择付费开放获取。
oa.en: Hybrid: optional paid open access.

preprint.zh: 综述只应讨论经过同行评议的研究，所以 WIREs 稿件不应引用预印本；但作者可随时把投稿前的版本发到预印本平台，发表后链接正式文章。
preprint.en: Reviews should discuss peer-reviewed work, so WIREs manuscripts should not cite preprints; authors may post the pre-review version of their own manuscript at any time and link it to the published article.

data.zh: WIREs 执行“Expects Data Sharing”政策，每篇都要有数据可用性声明（多数综述写“不适用”即可）。
data.en: WIREs applies an Expects Data Sharing policy; every article needs a data availability statement ("not applicable" for most reviews).

tpl.zh: 用 WIREs 的 Word 模板，说明写在模板里；没有单独的 LaTeX 模板。
tpl.en: Use the WIREs Word template, which contains the instructions; there is no separate LaTeX template.

scope.zh: 量子化学基础理论、量子力学计算方法及其应用的重要进展；与实验数据相互印证，或对实验可观测量、新材料性质有实质预测价值的理论工作尤其受欢迎。
scope.en: Important advances in basic theory and quantum-mechanical computational methods and their applications; theory correlated with experiment or with real predictive value for observables or new materials is especially welcome.

types.zh: Full Paper（150 词摘要、图形摘要和 75 词简介，正文须有可复现的 Method 部分）；Perspective：≤3,000 词、≤4 个图表、≤30 篇参考文献，附作者照片和 75 词简介；Software News and Updates（介绍软件、更新或算法实现，附性能数据和应用示例，商业内容为主的不收）；Review。主文档摘要不超过 200 词。
types.en: Full Papers (150-word abstract, graphical abstract and 75-word summary, with a reproducible Methods section); Perspectives: ≤3,000 words, ≤4 display items, ≤30 references, with author photos and 75-word biographies; Software News and Updates (software, updates or algorithm implementations, with performance data and example applications; mainly commercial content not accepted); Reviews. Abstracts are at most 200 words.

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可通过 OnlineOpen 付费开放获取，许可可选 CC BY、CC BY-NC 或 CC BY-NC-ND；不少机构与 Wiley 签有开放获取协议。
oa.en: Hybrid: paid open access through OnlineOpen under CC BY, CC BY-NC or CC BY-NC-ND; many institutions have Wiley agreements.

review.zh: 编辑一般会尊重作者排除特定审稿人的请求。
review.en: Editors normally honour requests to exclude non-preferred reviewers.

preprint.zh: 考虑已发过预印本的稿件，作者也可以随时把投稿版发到预印本平台，发表后链接正式文章；期刊参与 Wiley 的 Under Review 试点，投稿时可一键同时发布预印本。
preprint.en: Preprinted articles are considered and the submitted version may be posted at any time, with a link to the published article later; the journal takes part in Wiley's Under Review pilot, which posts a preprint at submission with one click.

data.zh: 鼓励数据共享（伦理、隐私或保密原因除外）。
data.en: Data sharing is encouraged unless prevented by ethical, privacy or confidentiality reasons.

tpl.zh: 与 Authorea 合作提供通用和 LaTeX 投稿模板，强烈建议使用；主文档可用 Word 或 LaTeX（也可用 RevTeX4），LaTeX 投稿时须另传 PDF。
tpl.en: Generic and LaTeX templates are offered with Authorea and strongly encouraged; the main file may be Word or LaTeX (RevTeX4 is accepted), and LaTeX submissions need a PDF as well.

scope.zh: 物理化学与化学物理的交叉领域，覆盖物理化学和化学物理的各个方面。
scope.en: The interface of chemistry and physics, covering all aspects of physical chemistry and chemical physics.

types.zh: Research Article（篇幅不限，但内容要撑得起长度；摘要 ≤200 词）、Review（须先申请预批准）、Perspective、Correspondence、Corrigendum。所有类型都会先经编辑筛选。
types.en: Research Articles (any length the content justifies; abstract ≤200 words), Reviews (pre-approval needed), Perspectives, Correspondences and Corrigenda; all are screened by the editors first.

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可通过 OnlineOpen 付费开放获取，许可可选 CC BY、CC BY-NC 或 CC BY-NC-ND；不少机构与 Wiley 签有开放获取协议。
oa.en: Hybrid: paid open access through OnlineOpen under CC BY, CC BY-NC or CC BY-NC-ND; many institutions have Wiley agreements.

review.zh: 严格的单盲审稿，每篇至少邀请两位审稿人；推荐审稿人时要注明有利益冲突的人。
review.en: Strict single-anonymous review with at least two reviewers; when suggesting reviewers, note anyone with a conflict of interest.

preprint.zh: 可以考虑已发在 ChemRxiv、bioRxiv、arXiv 等社区认可平台的预印本；投稿时须告知编辑相关预印本。
preprint.en: Preprints on community-trusted servers such as ChemRxiv, bioRxiv or arXiv are considered; inform the editor of any related preprint.

sources.zh: Angewandte Chemie 与 Chemistry Europe 预印本指南
sources.en: Angewandte Chemie and Chemistry Europe preprint guidelines

data.zh: 期望支撑结果的数据存入社区认可的公共知识库，必须写数据可用性声明。计算化学部分：要给出足以复现的全部细节；软件和方法必须正确引用；电子结构计算要给出所有驻点的几何结构（正文中的笛卡尔坐标或 SI 中的 Z 矩阵）、相对能量和绝对能量（Hartree），必要时写明虚频个数。
data.en: Data should be archived in a community-trusted public repository, and a data availability statement is required. Computational work must give enough detail to reproduce it and cite software and methods; electronic structure papers include the geometries of all stationary points (Cartesian coordinates in the paper or Z-matrices in the SI) with relative and absolute energies (Hartree), and the number of imaginary frequencies where appropriate.

tpl.zh: 模板汇总在期刊网页的 Author Guidelines 下；正文、图表和 TOC 文字与图放在同一个稿件文件里的相应位置。
tpl.en: Templates are collected under Author Guidelines on the journal site; text, figures, tables and the TOC entry go in one manuscript file at the proper positions.

scope.zh: 德国化学会（GDCh）的综合化学期刊，混合发表综述类文章、Highlight、Communication 和 Research Article。
scope.en: The German Chemical Society (GDCh) journal for all of chemistry, mixing review-type articles, Highlights, Communications and Research Articles.

types.zh: Communication（通常 2,500 词）、Research Article（通常 5,000 词）、Review（≤12,000 词）和 Minireview（≤5,000 词，两者都须先提交 Review Proposal）、Scientific Perspective（通常 5,000 词）、Viewpoint（通常 3,000 词）、Highlight（≤600 词）、Correspondence。TOC 文字 ≤50 词。
types.en: Communications (typically 2,500 words), Research Articles (typically 5,000), Reviews (≤12,000) and Minireviews (≤5,000; both need a Review Proposal), Scientific Perspectives (typically 5,000), Viewpoints (typically 3,000), Highlights (≤600) and Correspondences. TOC text ≤50 words.

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可通过 OnlineOpen 付费开放获取，许可可选 CC BY、CC BY-NC 或 CC BY-NC-ND；不少机构与 Wiley 签有开放获取协议。
oa.en: Hybrid: paid open access through OnlineOpen under CC BY, CC BY-NC or CC BY-NC-ND; many institutions have Wiley agreements.

review.zh: 严格的单盲审稿，审稿后依据审稿意见和编辑判断作出接收、拒稿或修改的决定。
review.en: Strict single-anonymous review; the decision (accept, reject, revise) follows the reports and the editor's judgment.

preprint.zh: 见 Angewandte Chemie 与 Chemistry Europe 共用的预印本指南：发表后要在预印本上更新正式文章链接，也可在发表后立即公开正式版本（以指南原文为准）。
preprint.en: See the preprint guidelines shared by Angewandte Chemie and Chemistry Europe: update the preprint with a link after publication; the final version may also be posted after publication (check the guideline text).

sources.zh: Angewandte Chemie 与 Chemistry Europe 预印本指南
sources.en: Angewandte Chemie and Chemistry Europe preprint guidelines

data.zh: 期望把支撑结果的数据存入合适的公共知识库；计算化学部分与 Chemistry Europe 期刊相同：给出全部驻点的几何结构、相对和绝对能量（Hartree），必要时写明虚频个数。指南附有数据报告清单（Data Reporting Checklists）。
data.en: Data should be archived in an appropriate public repository; the computational rules match the Chemistry Europe journals (geometries of all stationary points, relative and absolute energies in Hartree, number of imaginary frequencies where appropriate). The notice includes Data Reporting Checklists.

si.zh: 每个 SI 文件都要有简短而具体的说明，例如“图 1 数据的表格”；上传后要到校样阶段才能再改。
si.en: Give each SI file a short, specific description (for example "Spreadsheet for data in Figure 1"); after upload the next chance to change it is at proof stage.

tpl.zh: 期刊提供各文章类型的模板，另有通用 LaTeX 模板；正文、图表和 TOC 放在同一个稿件文件里。
tpl.en: Templates are provided for the article types, plus a general-purpose LaTeX template; text, graphics and the TOC go in one manuscript file.

scope.zh: 理论化学、计算化学和建模的所有方向，基础研究和应用都收；特别欢迎影响多个化学分支的工作。常规的 QSAR、对接研究和分子动力学的常规应用一般被认为不在范围内。
scope.en: All of theoretical chemistry, computational chemistry and modeling, fundamental and applied; work that matters across chemical disciplines is especially welcome. Routine QSAR, docking and routine MD applications are generally judged out of scope.

types.zh: Research（篇幅不设上限，在内容允许的范围内鼓励简洁）、Brief Report（原 Letters）、Mini Review（原 Overviews，通常 ≤30,000 字符，含表格和参考文献，最多 8 张图）、Perspective。
types.en: Research articles (no size limit; brevity encouraged), Brief Reports (formerly Letters), Mini Reviews (formerly Overviews, normally ≤30,000 characters including tables and references, up to eight figures) and Perspectives.

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可选 Open Choice 付费开放获取（见作者指南的 Open Choice 和 Open access publishing 两节）。
oa.en: Hybrid: optional paid open access through Open Choice (see the Open Choice and open access sections of the guidelines).

data.zh: 遵循 Springer Nature 研究数据政策，作者指南有“Research Data Policy and Data Availability Statements”一节，说明数据可用性声明怎么写。
data.en: Follows the Springer Nature research data policy; the guidelines have a section on Research Data Policy and Data Availability Statements.

sources.zh: Springer Nature 研究数据政策

tpl.zh: 稿件可用 Word（.docx）或 LaTeX；有数学内容时推荐 Springer Nature 的 LaTeX 模板。
tpl.en: Manuscripts may be Word (.docx) or LaTeX; for mathematical content Springer Nature recommends its LaTeX template.

scope.zh: 经同行评议的专门三维分子建模研究，例如计算机辅助药物设计（分子设计、从头配体设计、受体建模与对接、用于药物设计的分子动力学）等方向。由于来稿多、拒稿率高，范围页列出了各方向的自评指引，投稿前值得逐条对照。
scope.en: Specialized 3D molecular modeling studies, for example computer-aided drug design (molecular and de novo ligand design, receptor modeling and docking, MD for drug design). Because of the volume and high rejection rate, the scope page gives self-assessment guidelines per area; check them before submitting.

types.zh: Original Paper（研究论文）、Review（注意期刊对 Review 类型的最新说明）、Short Comment、Software Report、Brief Report。
types.en: Original Papers, Reviews (note the journal's update on the Review type), Short Comments, Software Reports and Brief Reports.

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可选 Open Choice 付费开放获取（见作者指南的 Open Choice 和 Open access publishing 两节）。
oa.en: Hybrid: optional paid open access through Open Choice (see the Open Choice and open access sections of the guidelines).

data.zh: 遵循 Springer Nature 研究数据政策，作者指南有“Research Data Policy and Data Availability Statements”一节，说明数据可用性声明怎么写。
data.en: Follows the Springer Nature research data policy; the guidelines have a section on Research Data Policy and Data Availability Statements.

sources.zh: Springer Nature 研究数据政策

tpl.zh: 稿件可用 Word（.docx）或 LaTeX；有数学内容时推荐 Springer Nature 的 LaTeX 模板。
tpl.en: Manuscripts may be Word (.docx) or LaTeX; for mathematical content Springer Nature recommends its LaTeX template.

scope.zh: 完全开放获取，化学信息学的各个方面：化学信息系统、软件与数据库、分子建模方法，化学结构表示及其在结构、子结构、相似性检索中的应用，化学反应数据库，以及更多计算方向（见期刊主页的完整列表）。
scope.en: Fully open access, covering all of cheminformatics: chemical information systems, software and databases, molecular modeling methods, structure representation for structure, substructure and similarity search, reaction databases and more (full list on the journal home page).

types.zh: Research、Methodology、Software、Database、Data Note、Review、Brief Report、Comment、Educational Article、Correspondence、Meeting report；各类型的格式要求见作者指南。
types.en: Research, Methodology, Software, Database, Data Note, Review, Brief Report, Comment, Educational Article, Correspondence and Meeting report; formats per type are in the guidelines.

oa.zh: 完全开放获取（BMC 期刊）。
oa.en: Fully open access (a BMC journal).

data.zh: BMC 期刊强烈鼓励或要求提供支撑结论的全部数据集，可存入公共知识库或放在正文和附加文件里，并用机器可读格式（例如电子表格而不是 PDF）；某类文章是否强制提供数据，见该类型的说明。
data.en: BMC journals strongly encourage or require all datasets behind the conclusions, in public repositories or in the paper and additional files, in machine-readable formats (spreadsheets rather than PDFs); whether data are mandatory depends on the article type.

tpl.zh: 主文档可用 Word、RTF 或 TeX/LaTeX；鼓励用 Springer Nature LaTeX 模板，投稿时系统用 pdfLaTeX（TeX Live 2021）编译 PDF，所有可编辑源文件都要上传。
tpl.en: Word, RTF or TeX/LaTeX; the Springer Nature LaTeX template is encouraged, the system compiles a PDF with pdfLaTeX (TeX Live 2021), and all editable sources must be uploaded.

scope.zh: 中国科学院和国家自然科学基金委员会主办、科学出版社出版，发表化学基础研究和应用研究中高质量的原创成果。
scope.en: Co-sponsored by the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the NSFC and published by Science China Press, it publishes high-quality original basic and applied chemistry research.

types.zh: Article（≤50 篇参考文献）、Communication（2,000–3,000 词，2–4 个图表，≤20 篇参考文献）、Review（≤8,000 词，≤100 篇参考文献，总结近 5–10 年的代表性成果）、Mini Review（≤4,500 词，≤80 篇参考文献）、Feature Article（多为邀请，≤8,000 词）、Perspective（约 1,000 词）、Highlight（约 500 词）。Review 选题申请有模板。
types.en: Articles (≤50 references), Communications (2,000–3,000 words, 2–4 figures or tables, ≤20 references), Reviews (≤8,000 words, ≤100 references, covering the past 5–10 years), Mini Reviews (≤4,500 words, ≤80 references), Feature Articles (usually invited, ≤8,000 words), Perspectives (~1,000 words) and Highlights (~500 words). A Review Proposal template is provided.

oa.zh: 可选开放获取（经 Springer Nature）；编辑部另外收取版面费，与 Springer Nature 的 APC 不是一回事，金额见编辑部网站。
oa.en: Optional open access through Springer Nature; the editorial office separately levies page charges, which are not the Springer Nature APC (see the editorial office site).

tpl.zh: 完整的作者须知是一份 PDF，可在作者指南页下载。
tpl.en: The full instructions for authors are a PDF downloadable from the guidelines page.

scope.zh: 化学所有领域中最重要、最前沿的研究：分析、无机、有机、物理等核心学科，以及催化、计算与理论化学、环境、绿色、药物、核化学、高分子、超分子和表面化学，还有与生物、材料等的交叉课题。
scope.en: The most significant, cutting-edge research across chemistry: the core analytical, inorganic, organic and physical subjects plus catalysis, computational and theoretical chemistry, environmental, green, medicinal, nuclear, polymer, supramolecular and surface chemistry, and cross-disciplinary topics.

types.zh: Article：正文 ≤3,000 词（不含摘要、Methods、参考文献和图表标题），摘要 150 词且不能含引用，最多 6 个展示项（图和表，期刊不用 scheme）；强烈建议写 Methods 部分，≤3,000 词。另有 Review、Perspective 等委约或评论类内容（见 Content Types 页）。
types.en: Articles: main text ≤3,000 words (excluding abstract, Methods, references and captions), 150-word abstract without references, up to six display items (figures and tables; no schemes); a Methods section of ≤3,000 words is strongly encouraged. Reviews, Perspectives and other content are described on the Content Types page.

oa.zh: 主要研究论文可选传统订阅出版，或付 APC 以金色开放获取发表。
oa.en: Primary research can be published through the subscription route or gold open access with an APC.

review.zh: 提供可选的双盲审稿（见投稿指南中的 Double-anonymized peer review 页）。
review.en: An optional double-anonymized review is available (see the Double-anonymized peer review page).

preprint.zh: Nature Portfolio 期刊鼓励在作者自选的预印本平台发布研究稿的预印本。
preprint.en: Nature Portfolio journals encourage posting preprints of research manuscripts on servers of the authors' choice.

data.zh: 所有原创研究都必须有数据可用性声明，说明解读和验证结论所需“最小数据集”的获取条件；用到对结论关键的自编代码或算法时，还须在“Code availability”标题下说明代码能否获取、怎样获取。
data.en: Every original research paper needs a data availability statement giving access conditions for the minimum dataset needed to interpret and verify it; custom code or algorithms central to the conclusions need a statement under the heading "Code availability".

scope.zh: 多学科期刊，关注计算技术和数学模型的开发与使用，以及用它们解决各学科复杂问题；既收显著推动科研的突破性算法、工具和框架，也收用计算能力获得新见解、解决现实难题的方法。
scope.en: A multidisciplinary journal on developing and using computational techniques and mathematical models to solve complex problems across disciplines, from groundbreaking algorithms, tools and frameworks to methods that use computing in new ways for new insight.

types.zh: Article：正文 ≤3,500 词（不含摘要、Methods、参考文献和图注），摘要 ≤150 词，≤6 个展示项；Analysis（对已有数据的新分析）：正文 ≤3,500 词；Brief Communication：正文 1,000–1,500 词，标题 ≤10 词，通常 ≤2 个展示项；另有 Review、Perspective 等（见 Content Types 页）。
types.en: Articles: main text ≤3,500 words (excluding abstract, Methods, references and legends), abstract ≤150 words, ≤6 display items; Analyses (new analyses of existing data): ≤3,500 words; Brief Communications: 1,000–1,500 words, title ≤10 words, usually ≤2 display items; plus Reviews, Perspectives and more (see Content Types).

oa.zh: 可选传统订阅出版或开放获取。
oa.en: Authors may choose the traditional route or open access.

preprint.zh: Nature Portfolio 期刊鼓励在作者自选的预印本平台发布研究稿的预印本。
preprint.en: Nature Portfolio journals encourage posting preprints of research manuscripts on servers of the authors' choice.

scope.zh: 用计算方法设计新材料、加深对已有材料理解的应用研究：有机与无机材料的理论与模拟，新兴与可持续材料，材料结构与性质预测，材料基本行为与退化，计算与实验验证结合的研究等。
scope.en: Applied computational approaches to design new materials and understand existing ones: theory and simulation of organic and inorganic materials, emerging and sustainable materials, structure and property prediction, fundamentals and degradation, and studies combining computation with experimental validation.

types.zh: Article：原创研究，标题 ≤15 词，摘要 ≤150 词且不分小标题，Results 和 Methods 用小标题；系统综述和荟萃分析也按 Article 投。另有 Brief Communication、Review、Perspective、Comment 等，各类型的正文长度在 Content Types 页逐项列出。
types.en: Articles: original research, title ≤15 words, abstract ≤150 words without subheadings, subheadings in Results and Methods; systematic reviews and meta-analyses are submitted as Articles. Brief Communications, Reviews, Perspectives, Comments and more have lengths listed per type on the Content Types page.

num.en: APC on the open access page (set by acceptance date, plus VAT or local taxes): Original Research £2,790 / $3,590 / €3,090; Brief Communication, Perspective, Review and Comment £1,355 / $1,870 / €1,545.

scope.zh: 以 Data Descriptor（数据描述论文）为主：论文与数据集一起审，适合发表计算化学的大型基准集、训练集和数据库（具体文章格式见 Aims & Scope 链接）。
scope.en: Mainly Data Descriptors, where the dataset is reviewed together with the paper; a natural home for large computational benchmark, training or database releases (formats are described under Aims & Scope).

data.zh: 投稿时数据就要能让审稿人通过任意可匿名下载的链接获取（可以是正式知识库，也可以是临时云存储）；从第二轮审稿起，数据必须公开存放在符合期刊政策的正式数据知识库中。
data.en: At submission, reviewers must be able to download the data anonymously from any URL (the final repository or temporary cloud storage); from the second round of review onward the data must be public in a formal repository that meets the journal's policy.

num.en: APC on the open access page (by acceptance date, plus taxes): £2,150 / $2,690 / €2,390.

scope.zh: 开放获取的多学科期刊，覆盖生物、健康、物理、化学、地球、社会、数学、应用和工程科学；论文要代表对本领域专家有意义的重要进展。
scope.en: An open access multidisciplinary journal across the biological, health, physical, chemical, Earth, social, mathematical, applied and engineering sciences; papers should be important advances for specialists in each field.

types.zh: 原创研究只有一种格式 Article，长度可以从短通讯到深入研究；另有 Registered Report、Matters Arising（对本刊论文的评论），以及编辑邀请撰写的 Review、Perspective 和 Comment。
types.en: Original research has one format, the Article, from short communications to in-depth studies; plus Registered Reports, Matters Arising on its papers, and commissioned Reviews, Perspectives and Comments.

oa.en: Fully open access with an APC.

review.zh: 期刊提供透明审稿（Transparent Peer Review）说明页；编辑流程见 Editorial process 页。
review.en: See the journal's Transparent Peer Review FAQ and Editorial process pages.

scope.zh: Nature Portfolio 的开放获取化学期刊，发表化学各领域高质量的研究、综述和评论；研究论文要为某个专门方向带来新的化学见解，期刊也希望成为各分支化学家讨论共同问题的平台。
scope.en: Nature Portfolio's open access chemistry journal for research, reviews and commentary across the chemical sciences; research papers should bring new chemical insight to a specialized area, and the journal is also a forum for issues that matter to all chemists.

types.zh: Article：建议正文少于约 5,000 词（Methods 不限长、不计入）；Review：建议正文约 6,000 词，最多 8 个展示项；Comment：通常 1–4 页或 ≤1,500 词，最多 5 个展示项。
types.en: Articles: main text recommended under ~5,000 words (Methods unlimited and not counted); Reviews: about 6,000 words and up to eight display items; Comments: typically 1–4 pages or up to 1,500 words, up to five display items.

scope.zh: 由 19 个物理化学与物理学会共同拥有，发表物理化学、化学物理和生物物理化学的原创前沿研究。最重要的录用标准是对物理化学有显著创新或洞见；实验、理论、计算和数据科学都收，计算工作也要用当前的方法。光谱、动力学、统计力学、热力学、电化学、催化、表面科学、量子力学、量子计算和机器学习都在范围内；聚合物、材料、纳米、能源等交叉方向须体现对物理化学的贡献。互补的实验与理论联合研究尤其受欢迎。
scope.en: Co-owned by 19 physical chemistry and physics societies; original research in physical chemistry, chemical physics and biophysical chemistry. The main criterion is significant innovation or insight into physical chemistry; experiment, theory, computation and data science are all welcome, and computational work must use up-to-date approaches. Spectroscopy, dynamics, statistical mechanics, thermodynamics, electrochemistry, catalysis, surface science, quantum mechanics, quantum computing and machine learning are in scope; interdisciplinary work must show insight into physical chemistry. Complementary joint experiment–theory studies are particularly appreciated.

types.zh: Communication（建议不超过 4 个印刷页）、Full paper、Review 和 Perspective（通常 6–20 页；另有 3–4 页的短 Perspective）、Tutorial Review、Comment。
types.en: Communications (recommended ≤4 printed pages), Full papers, Reviews and Perspectives (typically 6–20 pages; shorter 3–4 page Perspectives exist), Tutorial Reviews and Comments.

oa.zh: 投稿和发表都不收费；作为混合期刊，作者可选金色开放获取，官网写明 APC 为 £3,100（机构若与 RSC 有开放获取协议可能免付）。
oa.en: No fees to submit or publish; as a hybrid journal authors may choose gold open access, with an APC of £3,100 stated on the site (an institutional RSC agreement may cover it).

review.zh: RSC 期刊默认单盲审稿；部分期刊提供可选的双盲审稿，作者也可以选择透明审稿（审稿意见、作者回复和编辑决定信随文章公开）。
review.en: RSC journals use single-anonymised review by default; some offer optional double-anonymised review, and authors can choose transparent review (reports, responses and decision letters published with the article).

preprint.zh: 可把预印本（未经审稿的作者版）放到 arXiv、ChemRxiv、机构知识库或个人网站；只有 ChemRxiv 上允许放修改后的版本，但仍须是接收前的版本。投稿时要披露。
preprint.en: A preprint (the unrefereed author version) may be posted on arXiv, ChemRxiv, institutional repositories or personal sites; only on ChemRxiv may it be a revised version, still before acceptance. Disclose it at submission.

data.zh: 理解和核实研究所需的数据必须在投稿时可获取（建议存入合适的知识库，做不到时放进 SI），所有文章都要提交数据可用性声明；RSC 希望数据符合 FAIR 原则。
data.en: Data needed to understand and verify the research must be available at submission (preferably in a repository, otherwise in the SI), and every article needs a data availability statement; RSC wants data to be FAIR.

tpl.zh: RSC 提供 Word 与 LaTeX 的文章模板和通讯（Communication）模板。
tpl.en: RSC provides Word and LaTeX templates for articles and communications.

num.zh: 期刊页列出：影响因子 3.0（2025），首次决定时间 27 天（全部稿件）、34 天（送审稿件）。
num.en: The journal page lists an Impact Factor of 3.0 (2025) and first decision times of 27 days (all) and 34 days (peer reviewed).

scope.zh: 每期对应一次 Faraday Discussion 会议，主题是物理化学及其交叉学科中快速发展的方向；期刊发表会上报告的论文，以及会上提问、讨论和辩论的记录。
scope.en: Each volume belongs to a Faraday Discussion meeting on a fast-moving topic in physical chemistry and its interfaces; it publishes the papers presented and a record of the questions, discussion and debate.

types.zh: 论文须受邀，或由相应会议的科学委员会从提交的摘要中选中；论文在会上报告。投稿前先看即将举行的会议主题和摘要截止日期。
types.en: Papers are invited or selected from submitted abstracts by the meeting's scientific committee, and are presented at the meeting. Check upcoming meeting topics and abstract deadlines first.

oa.en: Hybrid.

scope.zh: 化学、材料与生物技术交叉处的理论和实验研究，关注机器学习、AI 和自动化工具的开发与应用，强调“数据优先”以保证可复现：分子、材料和配方设计的 AI 与高通量计算方法，先进数据流程，新的实验自动化等。不考虑：低通量的结构或机理计算研究、低通量的生化机理 QM/MM 研究、传统的分子动力学轨迹分析（指南列了完整清单）。
scope.en: Theory and experiment where chemistry, materials science and biotechnology meet, on developing and applying machine learning, AI and automation, with data first for reproducibility: AI and high-throughput computation for molecular, materials and formulation design, advanced data workflows, new experimental automation. Not considered: low-throughput structural or mechanistic computational studies, low-throughput QM/MM of biochemical mechanisms, traditional MD trajectory analysis (full list in the guidelines).

types.zh: Communication、Full paper、Commit（技术说明）、Review、Perspective、Opinion、Comment、Tutorial Review。
types.en: Communications, Full papers, Commits (technical notes), Reviews, Perspectives, Opinions, Comments and Tutorial Reviews.

oa.zh: 金色开放获取，官网写明 APC 为 £2,200（机构协议可能覆盖）。
oa.en: Gold open access with an APC of £2,200 stated on the site (institutional agreements may cover it).

review.zh: RSC 期刊默认单盲审稿；部分期刊提供可选的双盲审稿，作者也可以选择透明审稿（审稿意见、作者回复和编辑决定信随文章公开）。
review.en: RSC journals use single-anonymised review by default; some offer optional double-anonymised review, and authors can choose transparent review (reports, responses and decision letters published with the article).

preprint.zh: 可把预印本（未经审稿的作者版）放到 arXiv、ChemRxiv、机构知识库或个人网站；只有 ChemRxiv 上允许放修改后的版本，但仍须是接收前的版本。投稿时要披露。
preprint.en: A preprint (the unrefereed author version) may be posted on arXiv, ChemRxiv, institutional repositories or personal sites; only on ChemRxiv may it be a revised version, still before acceptance. Disclose it at submission.

data.zh: 代码和数据都要存入社区认可的知识库（没有时用通用知识库），审稿期间审稿人必须能访问；接收后，稿件引用的自编代码须存入 Zenodo、Code Ocean、Mendeley 等持久知识库，发表前提交代码或数据的 DOI，稿件中要同时给出软件最新版和存档版的 DOI。
data.en: Both code and data go to community-recognized repositories (or a general one), and reviewers must have access during review; on acceptance, custom code must be archived in a persistent repository such as Zenodo, Code Ocean or Mendeley, DOIs for code and data are required before publication, and the manuscript cites DOIs for the latest and archived versions of the software.

tpl.zh: RSC 提供 Word 与 LaTeX 的文章模板和通讯（Communication）模板。
tpl.en: RSC provides Word and LaTeX templates for articles and communications.

num.zh: 期刊页列出：影响因子 7.1（2025），首次决定时间 40 天（全部稿件）、46 天（送审稿件）。
num.en: The journal page lists an Impact Factor of 7.1 (2025) and first decision times of 40 days (all) and 46 days (peer reviewed).

scope.zh: RSC 的旗舰综合期刊，覆盖化学科学的全部领域，欢迎跨领域、挑战现状的大胆工作，单一方向或多方向交叉都可以。
scope.en: RSC's flagship journal across the chemical sciences, welcoming bold work that challenges the status quo, in one area or across several.

types.zh: 所有原创研究只有一种格式 Edge article：不设页数上限，预计多数在 4–10 页；另有 Review、Perspective、Comment。
types.en: All original research uses one format, the Edge article, with no page limit (most are expected to run 4–10 pages); plus Reviews, Perspectives and Comments.

oa.zh: 金色开放获取。期刊页写明 APC 为 £2,850，并注明 2026 年 7 月 1 日前投稿的免收（本页核对时该日期已过）；机构协议可能覆盖。
oa.en: Gold open access. The page states an APC of £2,850, waived for submissions before 1 July 2026 (a date already past when this page was checked); institutional agreements may cover it.

review.zh: RSC 期刊默认单盲审稿；部分期刊提供可选的双盲审稿，作者也可以选择透明审稿（审稿意见、作者回复和编辑决定信随文章公开）。
review.en: RSC journals use single-anonymised review by default; some offer optional double-anonymised review, and authors can choose transparent review (reports, responses and decision letters published with the article).

preprint.zh: 可把预印本（未经审稿的作者版）放到 arXiv、ChemRxiv、机构知识库或个人网站；只有 ChemRxiv 上允许放修改后的版本，但仍须是接收前的版本。投稿时要披露。
preprint.en: A preprint (the unrefereed author version) may be posted on arXiv, ChemRxiv, institutional repositories or personal sites; only on ChemRxiv may it be a revised version, still before acceptance. Disclose it at submission.

data.zh: 理解和核实研究所需的数据必须在投稿时可获取（建议存入合适的知识库，做不到时放进 SI），所有文章都要提交数据可用性声明；RSC 希望数据符合 FAIR 原则。
data.en: Data needed to understand and verify the research must be available at submission (preferably in a repository, otherwise in the SI), and every article needs a data availability statement; RSC wants data to be FAIR.

tpl.zh: RSC 提供 Word 与 LaTeX 的文章模板和通讯（Communication）模板。
tpl.en: RSC provides Word and LaTeX templates for articles and communications.

num.zh: 期刊页列出：影响因子 8.1（2025），首次决定时间 5 天（全部稿件）、33 天（送审稿件）。
num.en: The journal page lists an Impact Factor of 8.1 (2025) and first decision times of 5 days (all) and 33 days (peer reviewed).

scope.zh: 计算与理论化学中有意义的原创报告和综述：结构、电子结构、性质、能量学、弱相互作用、反应机理、热力学与动力学、催化反应、激发与超快过程，对象从原子、分子、团簇到表面和体相。稿件必须推进计算与理论化学本身；新算法及对已有算法的全面评估、把方法用于新类型问题尤其受欢迎，也包括用于电子结构的量子算法和机器学习方法、多尺度方法等。
scope.en: Original reports and reviews of significance in computational and theoretical chemistry: structure, electronic structure, properties, energetics, weak interactions, mechanisms, thermodynamics and kinetics, catalysis, excitations and ultrafast processes in atoms, molecules, clusters, surfaces and bulk matter. Manuscripts must advance the field; new algorithms, thorough assessments of existing ones and applications to new kinds of problems are especially welcome, including quantum algorithms and machine learning for electronic structure and multiscale methods.

preprint.zh: Elsevier 允许作者随时在任何地方分享预印本；接收后建议在预印本上链接正式文章的 DOI。
preprint.en: Elsevier lets authors share their preprint anywhere at any time; after acceptance, link the preprint to the published DOI.

sources.zh: Elsevier 文章分享政策（含预印本）

data.zh: 遵循 Elsevier 研究数据政策（原则是数据尽可能免费、少限制地开放）；具体要求以期刊作者指南为准。
data.en: Follows the Elsevier research data policy (data should be freely available with minimal reuse restrictions wherever possible); the journal guide for authors has the specific requirements.

num.zh: Elsevier 期刊页列出：影响因子 2.9，五年影响因子 2.9。
num.en: The Elsevier journal page lists an Impact Factor of 2.9 and a five-year Impact Factor of 2.9.

scope.zh: 分子、界面、凝聚相、纳米材料与纳米结构、聚合物、生物分子体系和能量转换与存储的简短报告。录用标准是质量、紧迫性和影响；实验结果要与理论直接相关，理论进展或非常规计算要与实验直接相关；不能是对已有工作的小幅扩展。
scope.en: Brief reports on molecules, interfaces, condensed phases, nanomaterials and nanostructures, polymers, biomolecular systems and energy conversion and storage. The criteria are quality, urgency and impact; experiments should bear directly on theory and theory or non-routine computation directly on experiment, and minor extensions of earlier work are not accepted.

preprint.zh: Elsevier 允许作者随时在任何地方分享预印本；接收后建议在预印本上链接正式文章的 DOI。
preprint.en: Elsevier lets authors share their preprint anywhere at any time; after acceptance, link the preprint to the published DOI.

data.zh: 遵循 Elsevier 研究数据政策（原则是数据尽可能免费、少限制地开放）；具体要求以期刊作者指南为准。
data.en: Follows the Elsevier research data policy (data should be freely available with minimal reuse restrictions wherever possible); the journal guide for authors has the specific requirements.

num.zh: Elsevier 期刊页列出：影响因子 2.9，五年影响因子 2.5。
num.en: The Elsevier journal page lists an Impact Factor of 2.9 and a five-year Impact Factor of 2.5.

scope.zh: 用现代计算方法（单独或与实验结合）发现新材料、研究已有的无机材料（金属、陶瓷、复合材料、半导体、纳米结构、二维材料、超材料）和有机材料（聚合物、液晶、表面活性剂、乳液）以及有机–无机杂化材料。欢迎新方法、对已有方法的改进和重要的计算技术进展。以模拟为主的论文必须有概念或计算上的新进展：例如用标准力场、普通技术、只报告常规平均量的分子动力学会不经审稿直接拒稿。
scope.en: Modern computational methods, alone or with experiment, to discover new materials and study inorganic (metals, ceramics, composites, semiconductors, nanostructures, 2D materials, metamaterials), organic (polymers, liquid crystals, surfactants, emulsions) and hybrid materials. New methods, improvements and significant technical advances are welcome. Simulation papers must contain new conceptual or computational advances: MD with standard force fields and ordinary techniques reporting conventional averages is rejected without review.

preprint.zh: Elsevier 允许作者随时在任何地方分享预印本；接收后建议在预印本上链接正式文章的 DOI。
preprint.en: Elsevier lets authors share their preprint anywhere at any time; after acceptance, link the preprint to the published DOI.

sources.zh: Elsevier 文章分享政策（含预印本）

data.en: Follows the Elsevier research data policy (data should be freely available with minimal reuse restrictions wherever possible); the journal guide for authors has the specific requirements.

num.zh: Elsevier 期刊页列出：影响因子 3.7，五年影响因子 3.8。
num.en: The Elsevier journal page lists an Impact Factor of 3.7 and a five-year Impact Factor of 3.8.

scope.zh: 1985 年创刊的同行评议期刊，中国化学会与北京大学共同主办，现由 Elsevier 出版。主要发表化学学科内物理化学方向的原创实验和理论研究，范围包括热力学、动力学与结构化学，理论与计算化学（量子化学、统计力学、模拟方法与应用、计算化学、化学信息学），电化学与新能源等。
scope.en: A peer-reviewed journal founded in 1985, co-sponsored by the Chinese Chemical Society and Peking University and now published by Elsevier. It mainly publishes original experimental and theoretical physical chemistry, including thermodynamics, kinetics and structural chemistry, theoretical and computational chemistry (quantum chemistry, statistical mechanics, simulation, computational chemistry, chemical informatics), and electrochemistry and new energy.

preprint.zh: Elsevier 允许作者随时在任何地方分享预印本；接收后建议在预印本上链接正式文章的 DOI。
preprint.en: Elsevier lets authors share their preprint anywhere at any time; after acceptance, link the preprint to the published DOI.

sources.zh: Elsevier 文章分享政策（含预印本）

num.zh: Elsevier 期刊页列出：影响因子 13.5，五年影响因子 7.5。
num.en: The Elsevier journal page lists an Impact Factor of 13.5 and a five-year Impact Factor of 7.5.

scope.zh: 分子科学的实验和理论各方面：从电子结构、分子动力学、光谱和反应动力学，到凝聚态、表面科学，以及简单和复杂流体的统计力学。
scope.en: All experimental and theoretical aspects of molecular science, from electronic structure, molecular dynamics, spectroscopy and reaction kinetics to condensed matter, surface science and the statistical mechanics of simple and complex fluids.

types.zh: 论文不设字数上限，但投稿时要写明字数。
types.en: No word limit, but include a word count.

oa.zh: 混合期刊：可通过 Open Select 付费开放获取。
oa.en: Hybrid: optional open access through Open Select.

review.zh: 编辑评估适合本刊后，由一位独立的匿名专家做单盲审稿；如果已把作者原稿发在预印本平台，匿名性无法保证。
review.en: After the editor's suitability check, one independent anonymous expert reviews it (single anonymous); if the original manuscript is on a preprint server, anonymity cannot be guaranteed.

preprint.zh: 可以投已发过预印本的稿件，具体规定和引用要求见 Taylor & Francis 的预印本说明页。
preprint.en: Preprinted manuscripts may be submitted; see the Taylor & Francis preprint page for rules and citation.

sources.zh: Taylor & Francis：把稿件发到预印本平台
sources.en: Taylor & Francis: posting to a preprint server

data.zh: 执行 Taylor & Francis 基础数据共享政策：在不违反伦理或法律的前提下，鼓励共享或公开支撑结果的数据。
data.en: Applies the Taylor & Francis Basic Data Sharing Policy: authors are encouraged to share or open the data behind the results where this does not break ethical or legal obligations.

sources.zh: Taylor & Francis 基础数据共享政策
sources.en: Taylor & Francis basic data sharing policy

tpl.zh: 可用 Word 或 LaTeX 投稿，图片与正文分开保存；期刊提供 Word 模板和 LaTeX 模板。
tpl.en: Word or LaTeX, with figures saved separately; Word and LaTeX templates are provided.

scope.zh: 凝聚态与材料物理中高质量、重要的进展，强调严格、公正、建设性的审稿，自 1970 年起覆盖凝聚态的传统和新兴方向。
scope.en: High-quality, significant developments in condensed matter and materials physics, with a rigorous, fair and constructive review process; it has covered established and emerging condensed matter topics since 1970.

types.zh: Regular Article（无长度限制）；Letter（≤4,500 词，优先处理，须在投稿信里说明为什么用 Letter 格式）；Perspective（无长度限制）；Comment 和 Reply（≤3,500 词）。
types.en: Regular Articles (no length limit); Letters (≤4,500 words, priority handling, justify the format in the submission letter); Perspectives (no length limit); Comments and Replies (≤3,500 words).

oa.zh: 可选开放获取（见作者指南的 Publishing Options），APC 价格见 APS 开放获取页。
oa.en: Open access is an option (see Publishing Options in the guidelines); APC prices are on the APS open access page.

sources.zh: APS 开放获取与出版权利
sources.en: APS open access and publication rights

preprint.zh: 可以投已放在预印本平台（如 arXiv）的稿件，投稿时要提供 e-print 编号。
preprint.en: Manuscripts already on a preprint server such as arXiv may be submitted; give the e-print number at submission.

data.zh: 2024 年 12 月 11 日起投稿 Physical Review 系列须附数据可用性声明（期刊会根据作者提供的信息协助撰写）；鼓励在发表时公开数据。
data.en: Since 11 Dec 2024, submissions to Physical Review journals need a data availability statement (the journals help prepare it from author information); data should be public at publication where possible.

tpl.zh: 推荐用 APS 的 REVTeX（LaTeX）排版；也接受其他格式，具体见 Information for Authors。
tpl.en: APS recommends its REVTeX (LaTeX) package; see Information for Authors for other accepted formats.

scope.zh: 材料研究中高质量、重要的进展，跨材料科学、物理、化学和工程的多学科研究。
scope.en: High-quality, significant developments in materials research, publishing multidisciplinary work across materials science, physics, chemistry and engineering.

types.zh: Regular Article（无长度限制，但长度要与内容相称）；Letter（≤4,500 词，加速处理）；Research Update（≤10,000 词，对重要热点方向研究现状的简短综述，不求全面）。
types.en: Regular Articles (no limit, but length should fit the content); Letters (≤4,500 words, accelerated); Research Updates (≤10,000 words, brief reviews of the current status of an important topic, not comprehensive).

oa.zh: 可选开放获取，APC 价格见 APS 开放获取页。
oa.en: Open access is optional; APC prices are on the APS open access page.

sources.zh: APS 开放获取与出版权利
sources.en: APS open access and publication rights

preprint.zh: 可以投已放在预印本平台（如 arXiv）的稿件，投稿时要提供 e-print 编号。
preprint.en: Manuscripts already on a preprint server such as arXiv may be submitted; give the e-print number at submission.

data.zh: 2024 年 12 月 11 日起投稿 Physical Review 系列须附数据可用性声明（期刊会根据作者提供的信息协助撰写）；鼓励在发表时公开数据。
data.en: Since 11 Dec 2024, submissions to Physical Review journals need a data availability statement (the journals help prepare it from author information); data should be public at publication where possible.

tpl.zh: 推荐用 APS 的 REVTeX（LaTeX）排版；也接受其他格式，具体见 Information for Authors。
tpl.en: APS recommends its REVTeX (LaTeX) package; see Information for Authors for other accepted formats.

scope.zh: 电子结构研究的理论和实验各方面，包括新方法的开发；面向整个电子结构研究社区，横跨材料、物理、化学和生物，任何研究电子结构的理论或实验技术都欢迎。
scope.en: All theoretical and experimental aspects of electronic structure research, including new methods, for the whole community across materials science, physics, chemistry and biology; any technique that studies electronic structure is welcome.

types.zh: 各 IOP 期刊除常规研究论文外还接收 Focus Collection 文章、专题综述等，接收哪些类型、长度建议以期刊主页“About the journal”为准。
types.en: IOP journals take Focus Collection articles, topical reviews and more besides research papers; the accepted types and length guidance are on the journal's About page.

preprint.zh: IOP 允许作者随时在任何地方分享预印本，唯一限制是分享时不得转让或让与版权。
preprint.en: IOP lets authors share a preprint anywhere at any time, provided they do not transfer or assign copyright when doing so.

data.zh: IOP 标准数据政策：鼓励共享数据、鼓励写数据可用性声明，但不强制，是否共享不影响录用；各刊适用哪种数据政策以期刊页面为准。
data.en: IOP standard data policy: data sharing and data availability statements are encouraged but not required and do not affect acceptance; each journal page says which data policy applies.

sources.zh: IOP 标准研究数据政策

tpl.zh: IOP 提供 LaTeX 和 Word 模板，但不强制；首次投稿只需上传一个 PDF（加上相关补充数据）。
tpl.en: IOP provides LaTeX and Word templates but does not require them; a new submission needs only a single PDF (plus any supplementary data).

scope.zh: 多学科开放获取期刊：一头是机器学习在各门科学中的应用，一头是受物理洞见启发的机器学习方法与理论进展。
scope.en: A multidisciplinary open access journal bridging machine learning applied across the sciences and advances in machine learning methods and theory motivated by physical insight.

oa.zh: 完全开放获取。
oa.en: Fully open access.

preprint.zh: IOP 允许作者随时在任何地方分享预印本，唯一限制是分享时不得转让或让与版权。
preprint.en: IOP lets authors share a preprint anywhere at any time, provided they do not transfer or assign copyright when doing so.

data.zh: IOP 标准数据政策：鼓励共享数据、鼓励写数据可用性声明，但不强制，是否共享不影响录用；各刊适用哪种数据政策以期刊页面为准。
data.en: IOP standard data policy: data sharing and data availability statements are encouraged but not required and do not affect acceptance; each journal page says which data policy applies.

sources.zh: IOP 标准研究数据政策

tpl.zh: IOP 提供 LaTeX 和 Word 模板，但不强制；首次投稿只需上传一个 PDF（加上相关补充数据）。
tpl.en: IOP provides LaTeX and Word templates but does not require them; a new submission needs only a single PDF (plus any supplementary data).

num.zh: 期刊主页列出：影响因子 4.2；从投稿到送审前首次决定中位数 5 天，到审稿后首次决定中位数 52 天。
num.en: The journal home page lists an Impact Factor of 4.2, a median of 5 days to first decision before review and 52 days to first decision after review.

scope.zh: 中国化学会的旗舰期刊，范围覆盖化学所有领域：开创性的概念、机理、方法、材料、反应和应用，同时强调化学对生物医学、纳米技术、能源、地球与行星科学等领域的核心作用。
scope.en: The Chinese Chemical Society flagship, covering all chemistry: groundbreaking concepts, mechanisms, methods, materials, reactions and applications, highlighting the central role of chemistry in biomedicine, nanotechnology, energy, Earth and planetary science and other fields.

types.zh: 只发三类文章：Communication、Mini Review、Research Article。
types.en: Three article types only: Communications, Mini Reviews and Research Articles.

oa.zh: 钻石开放获取：完全开放，录用文章的作者不付任何费用。
oa.en: Diamond open access: fully open with no fees for authors of accepted articles.

scope.zh: 综合性化学学术期刊，稿件以中文为主；英文稿件须先投国际顶级化学期刊并获得正面评价，再经主编同意方可发表。计算类稿件除达到普通研究论文的水平外还须：所用理论和方法足以解决所研究的问题；计算结果与实验现象、已有实验数据有较好的相关性；有深刻的化学见解和实质性的预测价值。
scope.en: A general chemistry journal publishing mainly in Chinese; English manuscripts are accepted only with the editor-in-chief's approval after positive reviews at a top international journal. Computational papers must also use theory and methods adequate for the question, agree well with experimental observations and available data, and offer real chemical insight and predictive value.

types.zh: 研究通讯（简短快速报道，含图表一般 2,000–5,000 字，即 2–5 个印刷页，实验部分通常放进支持信息）、研究论文（含图表一般 5,000 字以上）、亮点与观点、研究评论、研究展望、综述。新颖性特别高的稿件可申请“绿色通道”。
types.en: Communications (short and fast, usually 2,000–5,000 characters including figures, 2–5 printed pages, with experimental details in the Supporting Information), Articles (usually over 5,000 characters), Highlights and Views, research commentaries, outlooks and Reviews. Especially novel work may request a fast track.

preprint.zh: 须知写明不接受已在其他期刊、数据库、互联网等媒介（包括外文媒介）公开发表过的工作；投稿前若已发预印本，请先向编辑部确认。
preprint.en: The notice says it does not accept work already published in other journals, databases or on the Internet (including foreign-language media); if you have posted a preprint, check with the editorial office first.

si.zh: 常规和重复性的实验操作、化合物表征数据和图谱等放进支持信息（Supporting Information）。
si.en: Routine procedures, characterization data and spectra go in the Supporting Information.

scope.zh: 面向研究软件包的开放获取期刊。软件须用 OSI 认可的开源许可发布、有明显的科研用途，投稿人须是软件的主要贡献者；论文本身不应着重报告用该软件得到的新研究结果。
scope.en: An open access journal for research software packages. The software must be under an OSI-approved licence with an obvious research application, the submitter must be a major contributor, and the paper should not focus on new research results obtained with the software.

types.zh: 只发短篇软件论文；完整的格式见文档的“JOSS Paper Format”和示例论文。
types.en: Short software papers only; see "JOSS Paper Format" and the example paper in the docs.

oa.zh: 开放获取；投稿文档写明不收投稿费。
oa.en: Open access; the submission docs state there are no submission fees.

review.zh: 审稿流程在 GitHub 上进行，投稿人需要 GitHub 账号参与审稿。
review.en: Review runs on GitHub, and submitters need a GitHub account to take part.

items.name: Living Journal of Computational Molecular Science

scope.zh: 为分子建模与模拟的“最佳实践”类稿件提供同行评审的发表渠道：这些文章是“活文档”，在 GitHub 上随社区意见持续更新，可以是持续更新的综述、教程、软件包对比等。
scope.en: A peer-reviewed home for best-practice manuscripts in molecular modeling and simulation; these are living documents updated on GitHub with community input, such as perpetually updated reviews, tutorials and comparisons between software packages.

oa.zh: 钻石开放获取：投稿和阅读都不收费。
oa.en: Diamond open access: no charges for submissions or for readers.

scope.zh: 化学及相关领域的预印本平台，由美国化学会、日本化学会、中国化学会、德国化学会和英国皇家化学会等学会共同运营。只接收预印本；内容发布前不经同行评审，但会检查抄袭以及冒犯性、危险或非科学内容。现在也接收综述，但仍不收短篇快报、评论、观点和纯假设性的工作。
scope.en: The preprint server for chemistry and related fields, run jointly by societies including ACS, the Chemical Society of Japan, the Chinese Chemical Society, GDCh and RSC. It accepts preprints only; content is not peer reviewed before posting but is screened for plagiarism and offensive, dangerous or non-scientific material. Reviews are now accepted, but not short letters, commentaries, opinions or purely hypothetical work.

oa.zh: 公开阅读；预印本有 Crossref DOI（前缀 10.26434），迁移平台后原 DOI 继续解析。
oa.en: Open to read; preprints carry Crossref DOIs (prefix 10.26434) that still resolve after the platform move.

review.zh: 不做同行评审，只做发布前筛查。投到期刊前先查目标期刊的预印本政策。
review.en: No peer review, only screening before posting. Check the target journal's preprint policy before posting.

tpl.zh: 2026 年 1 月起 ChemRxiv 迁到 Wiley 的 Research Exchange Preprints 平台，网址仍是 chemrxiv.org，可用 ORCID 登录；旧链接和 DOI 继续有效。
tpl.en: Since January 2026 ChemRxiv runs on Wiley's Research Exchange Preprints platform at the same address, chemrxiv.org, with ORCID login; old links and DOIs still resolve.

scope.zh: arXiv 物理学下的化学物理分类（physics.chem-ph），理论化学、计算化学与化学物理的预印本常发在这里；稿件可以交叉列入其他相关分类。
scope.en: The Chemical Physics category of arXiv physics (physics.chem-ph), widely used for theoretical and computational chemistry preprints; submissions can be cross-listed to other relevant categories.

tpl.zh: 可投 TeX/LaTeX 源文件或 PDF；数据、代码和图片可作为附属文件（ancillary files）一起提交。只接受注册作者的投稿，新用户或在新分类投稿时可能需要背书（endorsement）。
tpl.en: Submit TeX/LaTeX source or PDF; data, code and images can go along as ancillary files. Only registered authors may submit, and new users or those posting to a new category may need endorsement.

review.zh: 所有投稿都经版主审核（moderation），核实内容是否合适、是否切题；这不是同行评审。
review.en: All submissions are moderated to check that material is appropriate and topical; this is not peer review.

oa.zh: 公开阅读；投稿时要为每个版本选定许可（例如 CC BY 4.0 或 arXiv 的永久非独占许可），选定后不可撤销，各选项的含义见许可说明页。
oa.en: Open to read; each version gets a licence chosen at submission (for example CC BY 4.0 or arXiv's perpetual non-exclusive licence), which is irrevocable; see the licence page for what each allows.
